name: Hausdorff free subgroup theorem in SO(3) formalized in Lean

insights: The parent (lebesgue-measure-oq-06) already proves Hausdorff's free subgroup theorem, but states injectivity of FreeGroup.lift through the underlying linear equivalences (≃ₗ), forgetting that the generators are isometries. The genuinely new content is to realise the embedding internally to the isometry group ℝ³ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℝ³ and package it as group theory uses it.

Freeness is stable under any faithful homomorphism: e ↦ e.toLinearEquiv is an injective group hom O(3) →* GL(ℝ³), and injectivity of a homomorphism out of F₂ is detected after composing with it. So the parent's lift into ≃ₗ factoring as toLinearEquivHom ∘ (lift into ≃ₗᵢ) transfers injectivity back into the isometry group with no orbit argument reproved.

The forgetful map is a monoid hom precisely because both groups M ≃ₗ[R] M and M ≃ₗᵢ[R] M use the same composition convention a * b = b.trans a; multiplicativity is then exactly LinearIsometryEquiv.toLinearEquiv_trans, and MonoidHom.mk' needs only map_mul.
'SO(3) contains a copy of F₂' is exactly MonoidHom.ofInjective applied to the free embedding: an injective hom is the same data as an isomorphism FreeGroup Bool ≃* f.range onto a subgroup.

Non-abelianness comes for free: two distinct free generators never commute (proved decidably via a map to S₃ = Perm (Fin 3)), and this transfers along the injective hom to give two explicit non-commuting rotations.

Axiom hygiene: the file imports the parent (which declares the axiom banach_tarski for the full ball decomposition), but #print axioms confirms every result depends only on the fully-proved hausdorff_free_subgroup plus propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound — 0 axioms, no sorryAx, no Lean.ofReduceBool (decide is kernel reduction).

nextSteps: Show the generators have determinant +1 to place the free subgroup in SO(3) (special orthogonal) rather than merely O(3) at the Lean level.
Derive non-amenability of the isometry group directly: any group containing F₂ is non-amenable, closing the chain to the parent's free_group_not_amenable.
Transport the free group's paradoxical decomposition along the embedding to a paradoxical decomposition of S² minus a countable set (the full Hausdorff paradox).
